invalid_recipient.advice: Permanent. Remove it. Retrying costs reputation.

mailbox_full.advice: Retry with backoff for a few days, then suppress.

mailbox_inactive.advice: Dormant or disabled. Suppress - these turn into spam traps.

reputation_block.advice: Stop sending to this provider from this IP/domain and remediate.

content_block.advice: Content or a linked domain triggered it. Fix the message, not the rate.

blocklist.advice: Delist first. Find the emitting source before you request removal.

rate_limited.advice: Drop concurrency and rate for this provider, then retry.

greylisted.advice: Expected on first contact. Retry after the window.

auth_failure.advice: SPF/DKIM/DMARC problem. Retrying will not help.

policy_block.advice: Recipient-side rule. Usually not your reputation.

connection.advice: Network/TLS/DNS. Retry, but investigate if it sticks to one route.

transient.advice: Temporary remote condition. Normal retry schedule.

unknown.advice: Unrecognised. Retry conservatively and add a rule.
